title: No Lives Lost
subtitle: 灾害应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 灾害应对（灾害防范·灾害与应对）
meta: 主题语境：灾害应对（灾害防范·灾害与应对）　|　核心词汇：victim　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 victim 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There was one ① victim of the flood, and for eleven years everybody in the village said there had been none, and then in 1985 the man who had gone out to check the pump was named on a stone at the top of the street. The ② victims of it, meaning the eleven households who lost everything on the ground floor, were never named anywhere, and my grandmother said that is how these things go.

In 1976 a woman two streets away was the ③ victim of a fraud: eleven pounds a month for eleven years, for a policy that did not exist, and she had kept every receipt, which is the only reason anybody believed her, and no victim, she said afterwards, is ever believed twice.

My grandfather was, in the end, a ④ cancer victim, though he hated the word: he said a victim is somebody something has been done to, that he had been a patient and not a victim, and that the difference mattered to nobody but him. In 1979 the whole street ⑤ fell victim to the same bad winter — eleven of us had flu at once — and he said that was weather and not a victim either.

The ⑥ victim of the story, if there is one, is the clerk who wrote 'no lives lost' in 1974: he was twenty-three, sent from another county, given eleven minutes and a form, and a ⑦ victim of circumstance if ever there was one. To ⑧ blame the victim, in his case, would mean blaming a man with a clipboard, and the village has never done that, and it has never forgiven him either.

The ⑨ victim they put on the stone, and I have stood at it, went out at six in the morning to check a pump that had been broken since 1968, and nobody had told him, and eleven households were dry because of it. The ⑩ victim none of us names, and my grandmother did name her once, was the woman at number eleven, who measured the water every hour for eleven hours and who could not walk past that street afterwards.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 受害者；受难者（灾害、事故）
B. n. 受害者（犯罪、诈骗等的）
C. n. 罹病者；患者（cancer victim）
D. n. （事件、处境的）牺牲品；吃亏的人
E. 固定搭配：fall victim to ... 成为……的受害者／牺牲品
F. 固定搭配：the victims of ... ……的受害者（们）
G. 固定搭配：victim of circumstance 客观环境的牺牲品
H. 固定搭配：blame the victim 责备受害者

items.q: There was one victim of the flood
The victims of it, meaning the eleven households
was the victim of a fraud
a cancer victim, though he hated the word
fell victim to the same bad winter
The victim of the story, if there is one
a victim of circumstance if ever
To blame the victim, in his case
The victim they put on the stone
The victim none of us names

answers.why: a victim of the flood 意为“洪水的受难者”，这场洪水有一名遇难者，而村里人十一年都说一个也没有。
the victims of it 意为“这场灾害的受害者（们）”，指十一户一楼被淹的人家，他们的名字从未被刻在任何地方。
the victim of a fraud 意为“诈骗的受害者”，1976 年两条街外的一位女士成了一场骗局的受害者。
a cancer victim 意为“癌症患者、罹病者”，祖父最终成了癌症患者，尽管他讨厌这个词。
fall victim to ... 意为“成为……的受害者、为……所害”，1979 年整条街都害上了那场严冬的流感。
the victim of the story 意为“这件事里吃亏的人、牺牲品”，要说这件事里有谁是被牺牲的，那是 1974 年写下“无人员伤亡”的办事员。
victim of circumstance 意为“客观环境的牺牲品”，他二十三岁，从外县派来，只有十一分钟和一张表格。
blame the victim 意为“责备受害者”，就他而言，责备受害者就等于责备一个拿着写字板的人。
the victim 意为“遇难者”，刻在石碑上的那位遇难者早上六点出门去查看一台自 1968 年就坏了的水泵。
the victim 意为“受害者”，我们谁也不提的那位受害者是十一号那位女士，她每小时量一次水位，此后再也走不过那条街。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 这场洪水有一名遇难者，而村里人十一年都说一个也没有。（victim）
十一户一楼被淹的人家从未被刻在任何地方。（the victims of）
1976 年两条街外的一位女士成了一场骗局的受害者，每月十一镑，交了十一年。（victim）
祖父最终成了癌症患者，尽管他讨厌这个词。（cancer victim）
1979 年整条街都害上了那场严冬的流感，他说那是天气，不是受害者。（fall victim to）
他只有二十三岁，从外县派来，只有十一分钟和一张表格。（victim of circumstance）
answers: There was one victim of the flood, and for eleven years everybody in the village said there had been none.
The victims of it, the eleven households who lost everything on the ground floor, were never named anywhere.
In 1976 a woman two streets away was the victim of a fraud: eleven pounds a month for eleven years.
My grandfather was, in the end, a cancer victim, though he hated the word.
In 1979 the whole street fell victim to the same bad winter, and he said that was weather and not a victim.
He was twenty-three, sent from another county, given eleven minutes and a form, a victim of circumstance.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: There was one victim of the flood, and the victims of it — the eleven households who lost everything — were never named anywhere.
In 1976 a woman two streets away was the victim of a fraud, and she had kept every receipt, which is why anybody believed her.
My grandfather was, in the end, a cancer victim, though he said he had been a patient and not a victim.
In 1979 the whole street fell victim to the same bad winter, eleven of us with flu at once.

The victim they put on the stone went out at six to check a broken pump, and the victim none of us names is the woman at number eleven.
